title: Anthropic Targets $1.4 Trillion Valuation in Blockbuster IPO
summary: Anthropic PBC is seeking a valuation of about $1.4 trillion in its initial public offering, in a bid to make history as the first frontier artificial intelligence lab to go public. Bloomberg's Bailey Lipschultz joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Oura to Buy On-Demand Doctor AI Service Counsel Health; Revenue Jumps 153% in Q4
summary: Oura Inc. agreed to acquire artificial intelligence and on-demand doctor service Counsel Health Inc. for $625 million, expanding its business following a scrapped attempt to go public.

title: Alibaba Chip Design Unit T-Head Files for Hong Kong Listing
summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.’s chip design unit T-Head has filed for a Hong Kong listing, moving ahead with a proposed spinoff of a business that supplies data center processors in China.

title: Amazon’s Ring Unveils Flying Security Camera
summary: Amazon’s Ring unit debuted a flying home security drone more than six years after first announcing the product, marking the brand’s belated entrance into the robotics segment. Chris Welch got an early look at the device that ships in January  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Tele Columbus Lenders Near €350 Million Financing in Debt Rework
summary: A group of lenders to Tele Columbus AG are nearing a deal to provide around €350 million ($392 million) of new loans as part of a planned debt restructuring for the struggling German internet service provider.

title: More Suicides at Spy, Cyber Agencies Scrutinized by Congress
summary: At least 11 National Security Agency and US Cyber Command workers died by suicide over roughly the past year, according to US officials and public records, a greater number than previously known.

title: Where Does Jensen Huang’s Dishonesty End?
summary: What does Jensen Huang’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy mean for US security? It’s up to Congress to investigate where Huang’s dishonesty ends, Dave Lee says. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Carlyle's Thomas Warns About AI Infrastructure Financing Risks
summary: Jason Thomas, Carlyle’s head of global research and investment strategy, says the Federal Reserve’s tightening aims to cool inflation by making cash more attractive, raising borrowing costs and encouraging savings, pressures that could also constrain AI investment. He speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Singapore’s Sea Reports 43% Jump in Quarterly Sales; Shares Rise
summary: Sea Ltd. shares rose after the Southeast Asia e-commerce leader reported 43% quarterly revenue growth, pleasing investors who have worried about stiffening competition.

title: Dangote Cement Pauses $1 Billion London Listing Plan After Rout
summary: Dangote Cement Plc paused its plans for a stock offering in London of as much as $1 billion after a global equity selloff weakened investor appetite.

title: Anthropic Hired UK Lobby Firm Charlesbye Before IPO, Adding to Sunak
summary: Anthropic PBC hired a lobbying firm run by the one-time aide to former British prime minister Boris Johnson, adding to the ranks of UK political veterans the company has recruited to handle mounting calls to regulate artificial intelligence.

title: CoreWeave Has a Sentiment Problem Even Strong Earnings Can’t Fix
summary: After a bruising week for artificial intelligence stocks, CoreWeave Inc. faces a high bar to convince Wall Street that the AI trade is alive and well when it reports earnings after the bell.

title: Path Robotics Quadruples Valuation to $2.5 Billion in Latest Funding Round
summary: Path Robotics, a fast-growing startup that develops software for autonomous manufacturing robots, has secured $300 million in new financing that nearly quadruples the company’s valuation to $2.45 billion.

title: Dangote Refinery Gets $4.1 Billion Orders in Top Africa IPO
summary: Africa’s biggest refinery attracted about 5.85 trillion naira ($4.1 billion) of applications for shares in the continent’s largest public offering to date, almost three times the amount it sought to raise, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Latin American Unicorn Clara Raises $105 Million for Growth
summary: Clara, a São Paulo-based corporate spending management startup, raised $105 million to expand its sales and engineering teams, build out artificial intelligence tools and enter new markets as it develops more financial products.

title: Amazon’s Ring Unveils $250 Flying Security Camera After Delays
summary: The brand’s entry into robotics also includes a rebranded version of Amazon’s unsuccessful Astro rover.

title: Anthropic Targets $1.4 Trillion Valuation in IPO
summary: Anthropic is seeking a fully diluted valuation of about $1.4 trillion in its initial public offering. The Claude chatbot maker is looking to make history as the first frontier artificial intelligence lab to go public, seeking to raise as much as $90.4 billion in the IPO and a private placement. Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern have the details on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Siemens Expands Chip-Design Business With Software Deal
summary: Siemens AG agreed to buy family-owned Lauterbach GmbH to expand its chip-design portfolio, part of a strategy of acquiring specialist technology firms to help meet rising demand for state-of-the-art semiconductors.
